import pandas as pd

# List of source CSV file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_0.csv",

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_11.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_12.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/training_14.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure revol_util column is integer type as per target schema
    df['revol_util'] = df['revol_util'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema: only 'revol_util' column of integer type
target_df = target_df[['revol_util']].copy()
target_df['revol_util'] = target_df['revol_util'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_55/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
